# Shortlist Pass

> Shortlist Pass makes Shorty, an AI coworker for small businesses and HOAs. Shorty knows everything a business sells, answers its customers around the clock, takes orders and bookings, posts to social media and handles the busywork. Owners just text him. Shortlist Pass also gives each business a public page that AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Meta and others) can read and act on.

Website: https://www.shortlistpass.com
Company: Shortlist Pass Company
Contact: connect@shortlistpass.com (business and sales), hello@shortlistpass.com (custom builds and tech)
Social: https://www.instagram.com/shortlistpass , https://www.facebook.com/shortlistpass

## What Shorty does
- Answers customers 24/7 about hours, menus, services and availability.
- Takes orders and bookings. Integrated with Square and Stripe; Shortlist Pass never touches the money.
- Keeps the menu, hours and specials up to date when the owner texts a change.
- Reports on the week in a line. Texting and social posting are available as add-ons.
- For HOAs: answers residents' questions about the rules, takes event RSVPs and shares community news. Free for every HOA.

## Pricing
- Verified Shorty: $50 per month. Answers customers 24/7, ordering, bookings, reports.
- Free Shorty: $0. Add your offerings and Shorty chats with customers about your business. Limited knowledge; no ordering, booking or marketing.
- HOAs: free.
- Sign up: https://app.shortlistpass.com/signup
- Claim a free Shorty: https://app.shortlistpass.com/freeshorty

## For AI agents
- Business pages, menus, upcoming events and pickup availability are published and readable. Orders can be started on a business's behalf; the customer reviews the cart and pays on the business's own page, so no payment details pass through an agent.
- ChatGPT plugin: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6abf0138fbb88191875bfcf06eca0dd9
- Claude connector: https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/shortlist-pass
- Agent API (plain JSON): https://app.shortlistpass.com/api/agent/v1
- Agent API documentation: https://app.shortlistpass.com/developers/agents
- Operations: search businesses, get a business, get a menu, get upcoming events and stops, start an order (creates a cart from offering ids and returns a cart_url).
